description: Ashmand's Book I presents Egyptian, Chaldaic, and Ptolemaic distributions of terms as distinct methods with different ordering or degree allocations.
why_they_differ: Chapter XXIII reports and compares the Egyptian and Chaldaic distributions, while Chapter XXIV gives Ptolemy's ordering and base allocation; the methods cannot be treated as one interchangeable table.
user_facing_note: These are source-fragment method descriptions; disclose the selected term system only after implementation review, and do not treat the Egyptian totals or Chaldaic sequence as a complete executable table.
